guides.title: Fix Rapid Battery Drain & Phone Overheating on Android
guides.symptom: Android phone battery drains in a few hours, gets hot to the touch, or drains overnight while idle
guides.description: Identify background wakelock hogs, configure Adaptive Battery, and restrict battery-hungry background apps.
causes: Rogue application maintaining a continuous background CPU wakelock
High location scanning and continuous 5G radio hunting in poor coverage areas
Display brightness maxed out with Always-on Display running at 120Hz
guides.whyItWorks: Android Battery settings track milliampere-hour (mAh) consumption per process. Setting background execution limits forces Android's Doze mode to suspend rogue apps when the screen is off.

steps.detail: Open Settings > Battery (or Device care > Battery). Review the list of apps since last full charge. Look for any app showing more than 15-20% battery usage, particularly if its 'Background' active time is much higher than 'Screen on' time.

steps.instruction: Put rogue background apps into Deep Sleep
steps.detail: Tap on the battery-draining app > select 'Restricted' (or on Samsung: Settings > Battery > Background usage limits > 'Deep sleeping apps' > add the app). Restricted apps cannot wake up or run background threads when you are not actively using them.

steps.instruction: Turn off Wi-Fi and Bluetooth background scanning
steps.detail: Go to Settings > Location > 'Location services' (or Wi-Fi scanning). Turn OFF 'Wi-Fi scanning' and 'Bluetooth scanning'. These features scan nearby radios constantly even when your Wi-Fi and Bluetooth are turned off in Quick Settings.

guides.title: Fix Android Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, & Mobile Data Connectivity Issues
guides.symptom: Phone won't connect to Wi-Fi, Bluetooth audio drops/fails to pair, or mobile data shows 'No connection'
guides.description: Troubleshoot cellular and wireless connectivity and perform a clean reset of Android Network Settings without wiping personal data.
causes: Stale DHCP client lease or corrupted wireless network profile
Bluetooth GATT cache desynchronization with paired accessory
Incorrect Access Point Name (APN) configuration after SIM card change
guides.whyItWorks: Resetting network settings flushes all saved Wi-Fi networks, paired Bluetooth device keys, and cellular APN protocol configurations, returning the Android RIL (Radio Interface Layer) to factory defaults.

steps.instruction: Toggle Airplane Mode to reset radio transmitters
steps.detail: Swipe down Quick Settings. Tap 'Airplane mode' ON. Wait 15 seconds. Tap 'Airplane mode' OFF. This forces the modem to re-authenticate with the cellular tower and re-establish Wi-Fi handshakes.

steps.instruction: Forget and reconnect to the Wi-Fi network
steps.detail: Go to Settings > Network & internet > Wi-Fi (or Connections > Wi-Fi). Tap the gear icon next to your network > tap 'Forget'. Re-tap the network and enter the password carefully.

Go to Settings > System > Reset options (or on Samsung: Settings > General management > Reset) > tap 'Reset Mobile Network Settings' / 'Reset Wi-Fi & Bluetooth'. Confirm with your PIN or fingerprint. Your photos, apps, and accounts are completely untouched.
steps.warning: This will forget all saved Wi-Fi networks and Bluetooth pairings. You will need to re-enter Wi-Fi passwords.
